description: luismc-delivery: Stop blocks (trains, agents, ETAs, watcher, registry, wording, questions), PreToolUse denies, SessionStart ledger summary, PostToolUse ledger writes (DELIVERYSPEC section 5). Opt-in: nothing happens in a project without .delivery/ EXCEPT the machine load guard (DL-77, DL-78): it is on in every project where the plugin is enabled, with or without .delivery/, and refuses new heavy work (tests, builds, installs, local agents) while memory is above 85% or CPU above 60% (limits configurable per machine and per project)
